root.name: MCP Server
root.shortdesc: Exposes GLPI as an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server: tickets, knowledge base, service catalog, projects, users/groups, and ITIL analytics, handled conversationally by AI assistants such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot.
root.note: Works for on-premise and GLPI Cloud instances alike. A small, temporary GLPI core OAuth fix is still pending upstream (already reported to Teclib). Private plugin - Cloud distribution is arranged directly with Teclib per the private-plugin mechanism. This descriptor is a preview draft; the download_url above is a placeholder pending the protected distribution endpoint. Subscription pricing and support terms: see the homepage.
